game.label: Your copy of Zoids Assault for Xbox 360, USA release: its disc image (.iso), or its extracted folder with default.xex.

prepare.label: Building the game from your disc. The first time it downloads a free compiler toolchain (about 5 GB) and takes 10 to 30 minutes.

options.label: I accept the Microsoft Visual Studio Build Tools license
options.note: The game is built on your PC with Microsoft's compiler and Windows SDK, downloaded from Microsoft.

license.name: Microsoft Visual Studio Build Tools license

settings.label: Display
settings.help: Borderless fills your screen and lets you switch apps quickly. Exclusive gives the game the screen to itself.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 720p is the console's own. 1440p is sharp on a 1080p screen. 4K needs a fast graphics card.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Off can lower input lag on some screens. The game still runs at its own 30 FPS either way.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: zoids.log from the last game, and install.log from the setup.

exit_codes.10: The game isn't set up yet. Pick your copy of the game on its page to set it up.
exit_codes.11: Zoids Assault Recomp is already running. Close it and press Play again.
exit_codes.12: The update to the new version didn't finish. install.log in the game's ZoidsAssaultRecomp folder says why.
exit_codes.13: The game couldn't be started. Set it up again from the game's page.

looks.reason: The game is started through its setup program, which rebuilds it after updates, so looks can't be added to it yet.
